title: Lashae Be Gour Pe Abid ka Tha Nouha Baba
body:
Lashe be gour pe Abid ka tha nouha baba
Qaid se chut ke ba eijaz mai aya baba
Laash dafnane ki mohlat bhi na paayi maine
Khench kar legaye be dardi se aada baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya kahun kaisi qayamath hui barpa run mein
Ghodaou se rounda gaya apka laasha baba
Khod kar qabr sitamgar Ali asgar ki
Nanhe bacche ka gala qabr mein kata baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek bimar ki bekas ki madad karne ko
Laashe dafnane ko ye qafela aya baba
Shumr ne baali Sakina ke bhi gouhar cheeney
Pyasi bacchi pe zara rahem na khaya baba
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar shahidou key hai naizao pe chadhae aada
Sar barehna sar-e-bazar hai kunba baba
Qabr-e-shabbir pe kehte the ye Abid Mazhar
Yad karti hai tumhein baali Sakina baba.
